questions.stem: Operators must be alerted when any meter's reading in an eventstream goes above a threshold. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Activator watches data such as eventstreams and takes actions, such as sending an alert, when a condition is met.

questions.stem: At Fernway, nobody is told when the nightly pipeline fails. What is the simplest fix inside the pipeline?

options.text: Add an Office 365 Outlook or Teams activity connected Upon failure to each activity that can fail

questions.explanation: A notification activity connected Upon failure runs when that activity fails. Use one per monitored activity, because an activity wired to several only fires when all of them fail.

questions.stem: A manager wants an email when a measure in a Power BI report visual drops below a target. What can they do?

options.text: Set an alert on the visual, which creates an Activator rule
Export the visual to Excel each day

questions.explanation: Power BI visuals can create Activator alerts that watch the value and send an email or Teams message.

questions.stem: Which three actions can an Activator rule take when its condition is met? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: Run a Fabric item, such as a pipeline or notebook

questions.explanation: Activator can notify people by email or Teams and can start Fabric items such as pipelines and notebooks.
